description: Default Tauri app capabilities: core IPC plus a user-mediated Stage 11-A workbook Save As flow. No Tauri shell-plugin permission is granted to the webview; KST's process lifecycle (Kst.Api sidecar launch and PID-scoped shutdown handling) runs from the Rust host, outside the webview IPC surface (see docs/security/S0_4B_TAURI_SHELL_CAPABILITY_REMEDIATION.md). The dialog plugin grants the chosen file path only for the current process, and the filesystem plugin may write that selected file only.
